items.label: 4 Sets of Peony Support Cages
items.value: This package includes 4 robust peony cages, each with a 12-inch diameter support ring and four thickened 4mm legs that are 24 inches high. The heavy-duty design ensures superior strength to support even the heaviest of blooms, providing long-lasting, stable support for tall flowers like peonies and other delicate plants.

items.label: Novel & Stable Design
items.value: The circular grid-like structure of the peony support cage offers a healthy growing environment for flowers by helping them grow upright. It prevents branches from splitting, reduces the risk of plants falling over due to high winds and heavy rain, and enhances the overall appearance of your garden by keeping your plants neat and supported.

items.label: Easy to Use & Adjustable
items.value: Setting up these plant support cages is a breeze. Simply attach the four legs to the ring, adjust the insertion depth based on the plant’s growth stage, and the stable rectangular structure will help provide firm, consistent support. These plant cages are easy to disassemble and store after the growing season.

items.label: Durable, Weather-Resistant Material
items.value: Constructed from high-quality iron wire and coated with a durable plastic layer, these peony rings are built to withstand the elements. They are rust-resistant and resistant to deformation, making them perfect for long-term use in both sunny and rainy environments.

items.label: Packaging Includes
items.value: The package includes 4 peony cages, each measuring 12 inches in diameter and 24 inches in height, The ideal size for most flowering plants ensures proper growth and stability.

items.label: Versatile Use – Indoors and Outdoors
items.value: These plant support cages are ideal for use in gardens, yards, lawns, or patios. They can be used to support a wide variety of plants such as peonies, roses, hydrangeas, tomatoes, coneflowers, pumpkins, cucumbers, melons, saplings, and more.
